findings.title: Public S3 Bucket: my-public-bucket
findings.description: Bucket 'my-public-bucket' is publicly accessible. Reasons: Public Access Block not configured, ACL grants to AllUsers
findings.remediation:
1. Enable S3 Block Public Access at account level
2. Enable Block Public Access for this bucket:
   aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket my-public-bucket --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
3. Review and remove public ACL grants
4. Review bucket policy for public access statements

findings.title: Open Security Group: sg-0123456789abcdef0 (web-server-sg)
findings.description: Security group 'web-server-sg' (sg-0123456789abcdef0) in VPC vpc-12345678 allows IPv4 traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on TCP protocol, ports 22. HIGH RISK: SSH (port 22)
findings.remediation:
1. Review the security group rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0:
   aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0123456789abcdef0 --region us-east-1
2. Restrict the CIDR to known IP ranges:
   aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0123456789abcdef0 --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
3. Add specific CIDR ranges:
   aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0123456789abcdef0 --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr <YOUR_CIDR>
4. Consider using AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of direct SSH/RDP

findings.title: RDS Backups Disabled: production-db
findings.description: RDS instance 'production-db' has automated backups disabled (BackupRetentionPeriod = 0). This poses a significant risk to data durability and recovery capabilities.
findings.remediation:
1. Enable automated backups with appropriate retention:
   aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier production-db --backup-retention-period 7 --preferred-backup-window 03:00-04:00 --region us-east-1
2. Verify backup configuration:
   aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier production-db
3. Consider enabling Multi-AZ for production databases
4. Test restore procedures regularly

findings.title: RDS Single-AZ Deployment: production-db
findings.description: RDS instance 'production-db' is deployed in a single Availability Zone. For production workloads, consider Multi-AZ deployment for automatic failover and higher availability.
findings.remediation:
1. Enable Multi-AZ deployment (requires downtime):
   aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier production-db --multi-az --region us-east-1
2. Note: This will cause a brief outage during conversion
3. Multi-AZ provides automatic failover in ~60-120 seconds
4. Consider cost implications (roughly 2x instance cost)
